name: claude
summary: @claude on an issue or PR works on it and opens a pull request; a person merges, and it never pushes main.

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.why: Claude's credential (`claude setup-token`); each @claude spends model tokens. Either this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; until one is set the run ends green with a notice

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.why: the alternative to CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, billed per token to the API account; set one of the two, not both
